transcript: Blair is the person who turns an ordinary Tuesday into the story you tell all year. She remembers your coffee order and somehow always finds the best song for the walk home. She is curious, quick-witted, and genuinely shows up when it matters. Her ideal night is live music, great noodles, and a conversation that runs past midnight. If you are kind, playful, and ready for something real, I think you should meet Blair.
